name: input_devices
chapter: Core mechanics: keyboard and gamepad through SDL events and the default bindings
note: Every step sends SDL device events (step `events`), not Actions: ou-game handles them as live ones (platform::DeviceState, the bindings of config::InputConfig, readDevices). Default bindings (no --config): Space jump, Left Ctrl drop, pad A jump, pad left stick move, pad left trigger target lock, pad right stick look [tru.exe 0x487710 defaults, docs/GAMEPLAY.md Controls]. Pad 1 is a scenario pad (padadd), no real device.
